explication: Kueue is a Kubernetes job-queueing controller. Users submit jobs and queue policies to the Kubernetes API; job integrations represent those jobs as Workloads, whose reconciler consults queue state and patches admission or suspension status. Admitted jobs can create pods, while admission checks, topology handling, failure recovery, and visibility provide specialized branches. The tree supports these architectural boundaries, though several documented integrations and MultiKueue dispatch implementations are not sampled here.
